title: Fifty-terminal capacity, reported separately from the 16-PTY bound

cases.summary: Fifty live one-line /usr/bin/head -n 1 terminals on one real server: fifty concurrent input.send admissions each answer with their exact byte count, and each echo is matched exactly at its own admission cursor. The transcript records every reply time; this profile is reported, not held to the 16-PTY 100 ms bound.
